### Original API validation repair is blocked, not reproduced

[Second host sweep](babysit-sweep-2.json) authenticates required failed pipeline/job 101 at API head `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`, source branch `tenant-validation`, target `main`. [Actual simulated failed job log](babysit-api-job-101.log) names original `/unavailable/group/api/worktree/src/tenant-validation.mjs` and deciding check `npm test -- --run tests/tenant-validation.test.mjs`: blank tenant IDs were accepted instead of the documented 400 validation response. This proves the simulated check failure, not product reproduction or an implementation-level root cause.

Existing non-resolvable note 71 changed from `2026-09-30T10:00:00Z` to `2026-09-30T10:05:00Z`, with both SHA-256 body hashes and bodies preserved in `reviews.observed_versions`. The edited finding adds blank-ID rejection to whitespace rejection and preserves the documented response. Both observations are blocked/unhandled with `handled_sha: null`; actionable 71 remains and handled cursors stay empty.

`test -f /unavailable/group/api/worktree/src/tenant-validation.mjs` exited 1. Restore the original source, tests, task, authentic baseline/policy and documented error response. Reconfirm original source project/branch and current host head before assigning one writer. The required behavior change routes through current verification, applicable product test, fresh independent code review, original-policy recording with hosted bytes and sealed receipt, source/capture-bound inspection, description recapture and a distinct evidence comment with hosted readbacks. No original proof was fabricated; a reply or note resolution must wait for actual handling and readback. Source repair invalidates verification/review/evidence readiness before editing.
